cases.translation: The Spirit of God came upon Azariah.
cases.explain: The preposition на (upon) in the accusative meaning 'onto/upon' governs the accusative case.

cases.translation: Having heard these words of prophecy from Azariah.
cases.explain: The genitive case expresses possession or source; пророчества (of prophecy) is genitive.

cases.sentence: Долгое время Израиль оставался без истинного ___.
cases.translation: For a long time Israel remained without the true God.
cases.explain: The preposition без (without) always governs the genitive case.

cases.translation: They turned to the Lord God of Israel.
cases.explain: The preposition к (to) always governs the dative case.

cases.translation: They turned to the Lord in their distress.
cases.explain: The preposition о (about/to) with the prepositional case is used with verbs of thought and speech.

cases.sentence: Род уничтожал ___, и город шел на ___.
cases.translation: Tribe destroyed tribe, and city went against city.
cases.explain: Уничтожал (was destroying) is a transitive verb governing the accusative case.

cases.sentence: Он убрал ненавистных идолов из земли ___.
cases.translation: He removed abominable idols from the land of Judah.
cases.explain: The preposition из (from) governs the genitive case.

cases.sentence: Он восстановил жертвенник ___ перед притвором Его дома.
cases.translation: He restored the altar of the Lord before the porch of His house.
cases.explain: The genitive expresses possession: жертвенник Господа (the Lord's altar).

reading.ru: Дух Божий сошел на Азарию, сына Адеда.
reading.question: Who did the Spirit of God come upon?
reading.explain: The text states: Дух Божий сошел на Азарию, сына Адеда — The Spirit of God came upon Azariah, son of Oded.

reading.ru: Господь с вами, когда вы с Ним.
reading.question: What is the condition for the Lord being with Judah according to Azariah?
reading.explain: The text says: Господь с вами, когда вы с Ним — The Lord is with you when you are with Him.

reading.ru: Долгое время Израиль оставался без истинного Бога, без священника, который бы учил, и без закона.
reading.question: What was Israel without for a long time?
options: Without true God, teaching priest, and law
reading.correct: Without true God, teaching priest, and law
reading.explain: The passage lists three things: истинного Бога, священника, который бы учил, и закона.

reading.ru: Но в беде они обратились к Господу Богу Израиля, стали искать Его, и Он открылся им.
reading.question: What did the people of Israel do when they were in distress?
options: They turned to the Lord, sought Him, and He was found by them
They built idols and worshipped false gods
They went to war against the neighboring nations
They moved to Egypt and settled there
reading.correct: They turned to the Lord, sought Him, and He was found by them
reading.explain: The text says: в беде они обратились к Господу ... стали искать Его, и Он открылся им.

reading.ru: Они вступили в завет, чтобы всем сердцем и всей душой искать Господа, Бога своих отцов.
reading.question: What covenant did they enter into?
options: To seek the Lord with all their heart and soul
To build a new temple in Jerusalem
To gather all the tribes of Israel
To remove all foreign nations from their land
reading.correct: To seek the Lord with all their heart and soul
reading.explain: The text states: Они вступили в завет, чтобы всем сердцем и всей душой искать Господа.

reading.ru: Хотя он не упразднил в Израиле святилищ на возвышенностях, сердце его было все же полностью предано Господу во все дни его жизни.
reading.question: What was true about Asa's heart, even though high places remained?
options: His heart was completely devoted to the Lord all his days
His heart was divided between God and idols
His heart became hardened against God
His heart was focused only on military conquest
reading.correct: His heart was completely devoted to the Lord all his days
reading.explain: The text says: сердце его было все же полностью предано Господу во все дни его жизни.
